what: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager. It runs index funds and ETFs under the iShares brand, active funds, private-market funds, and sells Aladdin, its risk-management software.
customers: Pension funds, insurers, governments, financial advisers and individual investors.
money: fees charged as a small percentage of assets managed
fees for beating targets and for distribution
moat: Unrivalled scale, the iShares brand and Aladdin's place at the centre of many investors' operations.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 19% last year with a 29% operating margin
Private markets and infrastructure acquisitions raise its average fee rate
Assets under management grow with markets even without net inflows
watch: Net inflows by asset class and the average fee rate.
